matches.title: Matches
matches.subtitle: Record a match from the touchline, then read it honestly.
matches.loadError: Your matches could not be loaded.

empty.title: No matches yet
empty.body: Add your next match. On match day you record it here with one thumb.

form.title: New match
form.minutesHint: 5 to 60. The usual length for your age group is filled in.
form.created: Match added. You can record it when it kicks off.

errors.opponentTooLong: Keep the name to 60 characters or fewer.
errors.minutesRange: Enter a whole number from 5 to 60.

tagger.title: vs {{opponent}}
tagger.loadError: This match could not be loaded.
tagger.notFound: This match does not exist or is not in your club.

sync.savedLocally: Saved on this phone. It will be sent when you are back online.

kinds.lost_ball_own_half: Lost the ball in own half

pad.label: Record an event
pad.ready: Tap a button when something happens.

disabled.before: Start the match to record events.
disabled.break: Between periods. Start the next period to record events.
disabled.over: Every period is over. Finish the match when you are ready.
disabled.finished: The match is finished. Nothing more can be recorded.

failed.title: Could not be saved
failed.body: The server refused these. They stay here until you try again or remove them.

shot.title: {{kind}}: where was it taken from?
shot.pitchLabel: Attacking half with the goal at the top. Tap where the shot was taken. Arrow keys move the marker, Shift with an arrow moves it further.
shot.estimate: An estimate from a model trained on professional matches. Use it to compare chances, not as a probability for youth football.

lineup.title: Who is on the pitch
lineup.before: Pick who starts. They go on at 00:00 of the first period.
lineup.closed: Between periods. The same players go back on when the next period starts; make changes after that.
lineup.emptyBody: Add players to your team to track minutes.
lineup.loadError: The squad could not be loaded.
lineup.saveError: The lineup change was not saved. Check your connection and tap again.

finish.title: Finish the match?
finish.body: The clock stops, everyone on the pitch comes off, and the match moves to review. Events still waiting on this phone are sent first.
